mintAuthority.summary: PYUSD has four genuinely native issuance surfaces: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana, and Stellar. Ethereum and Arbitrum use Paxos SupplyControl-listed issuer controllers with rolling limits and administrator paths that can change controllers, caps, SupplyControl, and token logic; Solana uses a Paxos-controlled 1-of-4 Token-2022 mint multisig, while Stellar uses the Paxos issuer account without an observed protocol supply cap. LayerZero OFTWrapper ingress/egress is bridge machinery reviewed separately under Bridge Risk and is not counted as native Mint Authority.

mintIncidents.summary: During a Paxos internal transfer, a technical error minted about 300 trillion PYUSD. Paxos burned the erroneous issuance the same day and stated that the cause was identified and addressed.

controls.label: PYUSD allowlisted supply controller 0x2fb0
controls.capDescription: Rolling capacity 1,000,000,000 PYUSD with a 277,777.777777 PYUSD-per-second refill; the mint-recipient whitelist contains only this controller.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711753, SupplyControl listed this EOA as an active supply controller. It can call token mint only within its rolling capacity and configured recipient whitelist, and it cannot raise that capacity.

controls.label: PYUSD token and SupplyControl administrator
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711753, this EOA was the PYUSD token default admin and the SupplyControl owner, default admin, and supply-controller manager. It can add or remove controllers, change controller capacities and recipient policies, and replace the token's SupplyControl contract. eth_getCode returned no bytecode.

controls.label: PYUSD SupplyControl UUPS admin
controls.evidence: SupplyControl is a UUPS ERC-1967 proxy whose implementation was 0xfab5891ed867a1195303251912013b92c4fc3a1d at block 25711753. Its _authorizeUpgrade path is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, held by this EOA.

controls.label: PYUSD token proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711753, the org.zeppelinos.proxy.admin slot resolved to this EOA and the implementation slot resolved to 0x8c35caa5fd5bdc64b6b11344ad57594a3676256a. Paxos documents that this AdminUpgradeabilityProxy admin can replace the implementation through upgradeTo or upgradeToAndCall.

controls.label: PYUSD Arbitrum allowlisted supply controller 0x2fb0
controls.capDescription: Arbitrum SupplyControl applies this controller's rolling capacity and mint-recipient whitelist; the numeric Arbitrum capacity was not independently re-read in this finding.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495275061, this EOA held SUPPLY_CONTROLLER_ROLE on the current PYUSD SupplyControl 0x19ed5c631edd34ac776368c377a855c42bc1876. Its mint calls remain subject to SupplyControl's rolling-capacity and recipient-policy checks, and the EOA did not hold the manager role that can change those controls.

controls.label: PYUSD Arbitrum token and SupplyControl proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495275061, the PYUSD proxy implementation was 0x9ce23fc2c05034a878411ebbf926664670f1c831 and its legacy proxy-admin slot resolved to this EOA. The current SupplyControl 0x19ed5c631edd34ac776368c377a855c42bc1876 used this EOA as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and its implementation was 0xb071515976bcfc69ca1f57babbb8f974b2c6867e; the former implementation 0xfab5891ed867a1195303251912013b92c4fc3a1d retains a stale SUPPLY_CONTROLLER_ROLE grant that remains an explicit anomaly, not an active EOA mint control.

The multisig had four valid signers — 2apBGMsS6ti9RyF5TwQTDswXBWskiJP2LD4cUEDqYJjk, 3QaqDJS5angcPhW1HsMbB74vJbzWNcy1r5bwtATUro7d, BfWsvypxRvQ4KUhyJ2gLeFEkhRx3LgfkVahXMj6Kz3LN, and AuVW19qwit2bxZqcspGZLsbq2ZiqosvryTNXE8UZSeGh — with one required signer.

controls.label: PYUSD Stellar issuer account
controls.capDescription: The classic Stellar PYUSD asset has no verified numeric protocol supply cap; the issuer account is the native asset-creation authority.
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63985979, Horizon identified the PYUSD issuer as GDQE7IXJ4HUHV6RQHIUPRJSEZE4DRS5WY577O2FY6YQ5LVWZ7JZTU2V5 with one self signer of weight 1. The issuer account had active revocable authorization and clawback flags and remains the native PYUSD asset-creation authority; no issuer-defined supply cap was observed.

review.evidence: PYUSD has four reviewed native issuance surfaces. At Ethereum block 25770471, Paxos controls the token and SupplyControl administrator path while two issuer EOAs remain rolling-capacity-limited SupplyControl controllers; the Ethereum OFTWrapper is bridge ingress/egress and is excluded from Mint Authority. At Arbitrum block 495275061, the same two issuer EOAs held SUPPLY_CONTROLLER_ROLE, Paxos held SUPPLY_CONTROLLER_MANAGER_ROLE, the token implementation was 0x9ce23fc2c05034a878411ebbf926664670f1c831, and current SupplyControl 0x19ed5c631edd34ac776368c377a855c42bc1876 used implementation 0xb071515976bcfc69ca1f57babbb8f974b2c6867e; the former implementation's stale role grant remains an explicit anomaly. At Solana finalized block height 417773444, the Token-2022 PYUSD mint authority was a 1-of-4 Paxos-controlled multisig. At Stellar ledger 63985979, the Paxos issuer account was the native asset authority with no observed numeric supply cap. The resolved 2025 incident remains bound to the primary mint and burn transactions and Paxos's statement. KPMG's monthly PYUSD examination reconciles reserve assets and token liabilities, supporting periodic reconciliation, while OCC and NYDFS records support prudential supervision of the issuer path.
